title: Day 100. He still doesn't feel like it.

lines.text: Day one hundred. He still doesn't feel like going. He goes anyway.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: I'm tired. I'll start on Monday.
That voice never leaves. Not on day one. Not on day one hundred.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: Just skip today. One day won't matter.
One day doesn't. But the choice you practise every day does.
So he made one rule. Shoes on. Out the door. Five minutes. Then he's allowed to quit.
Because feelings follow action. Not the other way round.
